files.processing: Existing full 164.472s loop attenuated by a single constant -12dB gain, quantized to 16-bit PCM. Duration, natural timing and existing 1.25s boundary overlap retained. No denoising, wind removal, transient classification, internal edits, gating, time stretching or added sounds.

processing: Bird WAV unchanged. Existing cricket WAV lowered by a constant 12dB only; same duration, sample rate and existing boundary crossfade. No noise-removal claims. Playback, filters, plans, fades and preferences unchanged.
playback: One lazily fetched native loop per plan; same-track scene/phase changes retain source and adjust gain/filter over 4s. Morning/day winter bird level is lower. Indoor room/engawa gains .28/.42; outdoor roof/garden .72/.9. Winter evening reuses the full existing bird recording at .08 versus winter daytime .12; no added recording, edits or download size.

analysis.interpretation: Cricket full-file RMS was 13.13dB above birds, now 1.13dB above. Numeric evidence only, not equal perceived loudness or absence of noise. Low-frequency energy alone cannot rule out wind/voices. No clipping detected.
